Class DataBase<T>

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Serialization
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a generic database for storing and managing objects of type T.

public class DataBase<T> where T : DataObject

Type Parameters

T

The base type of objects stored in the database. T must inherit from DataObject.

This class supports storing multiple derived types of T. Each derived type is managed in its own internal dictionary, allowing for type-safe retrieval and organization.

Remarks

The database organizes objects by their runtime type, enabling efficient storage and lookup for polymorphic scenarios. Use the provided Add methods to insert single objects, collections, or entire dictionaries.
